question: interior-finishes-to-schedule
unit: sum for the whole finishes-schedule package on one tenancy floor (800 m2 NLA)

band.unit: sum for the whole finishes-schedule package on one tenancy floor (800 m2 NLA)
band.basis: Bottom-up sum of published QV CostBuilder Auckland rates for each of the six specified finishes plus the amortised items, with three stated proxies (Type II wall covering weight, plank-format LVT wear layer, 60mm-centre batten line) and four labelled allowances (offcut waste/rubbish removal; site measure, setout drawings and out-of-hours access loading; wall substrate sanding/stopping; and within the components, the transition-strip and floor-protection quantities which the schedule does not state). Allowances are about 7% of the midpoint, so they do not drive the result. QV rates are GST-exclusive, reviewed for Auckland, and UNREVIEWED by QV. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, base-build linings, ceilings, joinery, and floor levelling beyond a latex smoothing compound, as per the fixed scope. Midpoint is $171,487, or $214/m2 over 800 m2 NLA; low end $184/m2, high end $244/m2. Confidence reduced to medium by the LVT, Type II wall-covering and batten proxies, and by the unpublished out-of-hours loading, which is the largest single swing item not resting on a QV row.

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor)
band.basis: Additive build-up of QV CostBuilder Auckland rows for all six finishes plus floor levelling, transitions and protection, with two labelled allowances (site measure/setout; out-of-hours access loading) and one estimated tonnage against a cited QV tipping rate. Midpoint $163,000 = $203/m2 over 800 m2 NLA; low $173/m2, high $238/m2. Main drivers: carpet tile 640 m2 ($64,000-72,960, QV loose-lay heavy-duty nylon $100-114/m2 - market quotations for SDN tile start lower, from $49/sqm installed, so the low end is a downward risk), latex smoothing compound 730 m2 ($24,674-36,500, QV $33.80-50/m2, materially above the $22/m2 used in the brief), vinyl wall covering ($61-72/m2) and 340 m2 of acrylic painting. The timber batten wall is the widest single line (24 m2, $264-670/m2) because '60mm centres' may mean pitch or gap. Substrate sanding/sealing is treated as inside the cited paint and wall-covering rates and is NOT added again; if the plasterboard is not already at Level 4, add QV 'Stopping To Level 4 Finish To walls' (AKL 17.2-22.6/m2) over the wall area. Excluded as instructed: GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent fees, linings, ceilings, joinery, existing-finish removal, scaffolding and permanent lift protection. All QV rows are unreviewed.
